intended_object: The coordinate Hopf algebra over k of the group of multiplicative type obtained by Galois descent of D(M) along a finite Galois extension L/k. It is (L[M])^{Gal(L/k)}, where σ sends a·e^m to σ(a)·e^{ρ(σ)m}, viewed as a finite-type commutative Hopf k-algebra (Milne, Algebraic Groups, Theorem 12.23). This comes from the docstring and the module documentation.
